issues.text: New sentence: the HPA leaves the count alone when measured is "only a little away" from the target, but I am not told how little. In quiz q2 (80% measured vs 50% target) I hesitated over whether 80 counts as "a little away" before choosing to scale to 2.
issues.quote: when measured is only a little away from the target, the HPA leaves the count as it is
issues.fix: Add a few words giving a sense of scale, e.g. "only a little away (a few percent of the target, not 80% against 50%)", without naming the setting.
